itemList.description:
Supplying, Placing & Compacting Ready Made Plant mixed Cold Bituminous Pothole patching mix in accordance with IRC 116-2014 in 50kgs plastic sturdy bags. The mix shall contain at least 5.6% MC 800 Cutback Bitumen conforming to IS 217 Specification and suitable anti-stripping agent @ 0.3% by weight. The mix shall be workable for at least 6 months. The material shall be intended for patching potholes up to 40mm thick layers and for deeper potholes, the mix shall be Supplied as per technical specifications.
1) The mix contains volatile Kerosene and sealed bags shall not be stored in closed building or Warehouse. Properly ventilated place is preferred.
2) The mixed material should not be stockpiled not higher than
1.5 m for the first 48 hours. The necessary indented supply of cold bituminous Mixes shall be supplied in package from maker of Eco-Fix (CSIR-CRRI’S Steel Slag Cold mix) HINCOL or any Equivalent brand to the place as specified by engineer in charge including loading, unloading and lead & Lift
